narrative:
Chart of Accounts administration — the planning COA maps source GL accounts from VITREA's ledger (SAP S/4HANA FI) to planning accounts across the income statement, balance sheet and cash flow. Cost of care is split into medical supplies and catering, the clinical workforce, and facility and third-party services.

AI Auto-Map suggests mappings for unmapped GL codes using Cortex, with a confidence score and reviewer sign-off on every suggestion — useful when the Paracelsus clinics' charts of accounts are migrated.
